discovery: First laboratory achievement of a burning plasma and fusion ignition with target gain above unity by inertial confinement

nominees.name: Alex B. Zylstra
nominees.affiliation: Pacific Fusion (formerly Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory), USA

motivation: For seventy years controlled thermonuclear ignition was a promise. In 2021-2022 at the National Ignition Facility it became a measured fact. Hurricane led the physics programme that turned indirect-drive implosions from anomalous underperformance into a controlled scientific path. That path ran through alpha-heating-dominated and then burning-plasma regimes, reported in Nature in 2022. Kritcher's hohlraum and capsule designs, and Zylstra's analysis showing the burning-plasma state and satisfying the Lawson ignition criterion, were decisive. On 5 December 2022 the target released 3.15 MJ from 2.05 MJ of laser energy. It was the first laboratory fusion gain above unity, and later shots reproduced and exceeded it. This is physics in its best sense: first-principles radiation-hydrodynamics, precise diagnostics and careful engineering together produced a new state of matter on demand. It changed what experimentalists can measure and what fusion engineers can plan to build.
